claims.subject: Quantum Computing Inc.

claims.claim_text: Company substantially completed buildout of its TFLN chip R&D, prototyping and small-batch manufacturing facility (AZ Chips Facility) in Tempe Arizona in March 2025, and is planning FAB 2 high-volume facility.
claims.subject: Quantum Computing Inc.
claims.object_value: AZ Chips Facility substantially complete March 2025; FAB 2 in planning
claims.source_quote: In March 2025, the Company substantially completed the buildout of its state-of-the-art TFLN chip research and development, prototyping and small-batch manufacturing facility in a leased space within Arizona State University's Research Park in Tempe, Arizona (the AZ Chips Facility). In addition, the Company is in the planning stages for another higher volume manufacturing facility, which we sometimes refer to as FAB 2.

claims.claim_text: QCi completed the acquisition of Luminar Semiconductor, Inc. (LSI) from Luminar Technologies' bankruptcy estate on February 2, 2026, for $110.0 million cash; LSI brings 23 issued + 16 pending US patents and III-V photonic semiconductor fab capability.

claims.predicate: completed Section 363 bankruptcy stalking-horse acquisition of LSI
claims.object_value: $110.0M cash purchase price; closing Feb 2, 2026; consideration approx $97.5M cash + $11.0M escrow at closing
claims.source_quote: On December 15, 2025, the Company entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement with Luminar Technologies, Inc. ... and Luminar Semiconductor, Inc. ... for a total purchase price of $110.0 million in cash... The Transaction was completed on February 2, 2026. The consideration paid by the Company at closing consisted of approximately $97.5 million in cash, along with the $11.0 million of funds that were placed with an escrow agent...

claims.claim_text: QCi is the defendant in a securities class action (filed 2/25/2025) alleging the Company made false/misleading statements about customers, contracts, and business operations between March 30, 2020 and January 15, 2025; second amended complaint filed Feb 13, 2026 specifically alleges omissions and misrepresentations related to Quad M, QPhoton, NASA, millionways, and the TFLN foundry. Multiple shareholder derivative actions (March/May/June/September 2025) are stayed pending the motion to dismiss.
claims.subject: Quantum Computing Inc.
claims.predicate: ongoing securities-fraud litigation with specific named claim subjects (NASA, TFLN foundry, QPhoton, millionways)
claims.object_value: Active class-action against Co. + officers; allegations span 3/30/2020 to 1/15/2025; specific subjects of alleged misstatement include NASA contract and TFLN foundry
claims.source_quote: the complaint alleges omissions and misrepresentations related to Quad M, QPhoton, NASA, millionways, and the TFLN foundry. ... a class action lawsuit was filed against the Company and certain of its current and past officers in the New Jersey District Court... alleging violations of Section 10(b) and 20(a) of the Exchange Act. The complaint alleges that the Company made false and/or misleading statements and/or failed to disclose material information about the Company's customers, contracts and business operations.
